name: kyw-dev
description: Spec-driven development workflows for durable docs, verified Tasks, and audits.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, implement, deliver, and audit spec-driven work.
interface.longDescription: Provides six explicit workflows for decisions, useful project documentation, minimal Task records, implementation, independent audit, and separate PR, merge, and release actions.
defaultPrompt: Use $kyw-init to initialize this repository's durable documents.
Use $kyw-task "goal" to author a minimal ready Task record.
Use $kyw-impl 0001 to implement an existing Task through repository completion, then stop.
Use $kyw-deliver 0001 to prepare relevant commits, push, and one PR.
Use $kyw-audit 0001 to audit Task 0001 without modifying the repository.
